course_code_network.shared_infrastructure: Self-built site (creator states "I designed and coded this site, recorded all these videos"); video assets served from Amazon S3 bucket s3.amazonaws.com/acct-videos/ (shared across sites)
course_code_network.shared_template_evidence: Verbatim free-preview line across sites: "The first video of Chapter 1: The Accounting Equation is available for free preview" (Topic-1 variant on ACC 201 sites); identical structure (video lessons + practice problems + study guides; no live/1-on-1); identical <coursecode>.com naming
course_code_network.seo_content_model: One domain per course code (acct2301.com, acc201uky.com, acg2021fiu.com…), each exact-matching a school's intro course code for organic search. Freemium: first chapter/topic free, rest paid. Content = pre-recorded chapter videos (~13 chapters, ~90–100 videos, ~16 hrs) + practice problems + study guides, mapped to the specific course. Scales by cloning the template per new course code.
